messages:
sam: Quick Q — API contract for unknown model IDs + region/tier hints? I'm blocked on a tiny PR that changes the error shape, need a decision before merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342 :eyes:

alex: Which endpoint is this touching? /v1/generate or the model-selection helper?

sam: /v1/generate (the public gen endpoint). Current prod behavior: 404 + body: {"error":"model not found"}. My patch attempts a soft-resolve using region/tier hints and returns 200 with served_model set when we can auto-map.

emily: My strong preference is: do NOT change error->200 silently. Clients rely on 4xx to surface config mistakes. But we can add a safe resolution path that is explicit and opt-in.

alex: +1 to explicit behavior. Can you sketch the contract you want?

sam: Proposed contract (summary):
1) If requested model ID exists in catalog -> normal 200 response, include served_model field (string) as today.
2) Else if model not found AND client provided region_hint/tier_hint -> attempt compatibility mapping (catalog family match, quantization/seq-len compat, region availability). If mapping yields a single compatible variant, return 200 and set served_model to the resolved ID and add meta.served_via = "compat-map" and meta.fallback_reason = "hint-resolve".
3) Else -> 404 with the existing error schema (do NOT add new fields to 4xx bodies).

Example request:
```json
{
  "model": "mistral-unknown-8k",
  "region_hint": "eu-west-1",
  "tier_hint": "dedicated",
  "input": "..."
}
```
Example success response (auto-mapped):
```json
{
  "id": "resp_123",
  "served_model": "mistral-8k-compat-v2",
  "meta": { "served_via": "compat-map", "fallback_reason": "hint-resolve" },
  "output": "..."
}
```
Example error when we can't resolve:
```json
HTTP/1.1 404
{ "error": "model_not_found", "requested_model": "mistral-unknown-8k" }
```

emily: This preserves backward compatibility for errors (good). Two asks: (a) require the compat mapping to be deterministic (no randomized tie-breakers), (b) include an opt-in header or query param to allow clients to accept automatic fallbacks (e.g., X-Allow-Auto-Resolve: 1). That way we avoid surprising callers.

jin: For rollout, let's gate this behind a feature flag per-customer (default off) and an infra-side canary for internal customers. Also add an audit log entry when auto-resolve happens.

alex: Sounds sensible. For the PR: please add unit tests for the three branches, a deterministic resolution priority (region > tier > family fallback), and a runtime flag check. I'll only approve if errors don't change shape.

sam: Will update PR: add X-Allow-Auto-Resolve header, feature-flag guard, audit log, tests, and docs snippet. Pinged codeowners in PR description.

ci-bot: build/test pipeline passed for commit abc123 — integration tests ran (mock catalog).

alex: Thanks. Once tests and the feature-flag are in place I'll do review. If you want faster unblocking for internal teams, we can flip flag for staging only.

sam: Great — staging flag flip planned. I'll mark PR WIP -> ready after tests. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
